summary: Clean Energy Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with Coventry Enterprises LLC for a $166,500 convertible promissory note at a $150,000 purchase price, netting $141,000 after expenses. The note matures May 1, 2027, carries a 12% one-time interest, and is payable in 10 monthly installments of $18,648. Conversion post-default is at 85% of the lowest closing bid price over ten prior trading days, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap and Nasdaq shareholder approval requirements. This is a routine financing for general working capital, not a special situation. Proceeds support operations; watch for dilution upon default or conversion.
